featured_reviews.name: Sonali Bangera
featured_reviews.review_text:
My niece takes Bharatnatyam classes with Nikita Teacher and I am truly impressed with her commitment towards her profession! As a passionate perfectionist, she brings an incredible energy and dedication to her teaching. Nikita Teacher is a dance teacher known for her unique blend of warmth and discipline. In the studio, her laughter often echoes off the walls, creating an atmosphere where creativity thrives. She encourages her students to express themselves, celebrating their individuality and helping them find their own rhythm.
However, when it came to technique and performance, her demeanor is shifted. Nikita Teacher has high standards and does not hesitate to instill a sense of accountability. She  pushes her students to perfect every movement, her stern gaze reminding them that excellence requires hard work and dedication.
Her attention to detail is unmatched; every posture and hand gesture is meticulously explained and refined, ensuring that students truly grasp the art form.
Her choreography is nothing short of brilliant. Each piece she creates is a perfect blend of tradition and innovation, reflecting her deep love for dance. She nurtures her students' individual styles while pushing them to reach their full potential. Classes are challenging yet rewarding, and her encouragement fosters a supportive environment.
If you're serious about learning Bharatnatyam and want to work with someone who genuinely loves her profession, Nikita teacher is the perfect choice!

If you're looking for a fun and effective way to learn dance, Nikita is the go to instructor for you. Her knowledge, patience, and positive attitude create a welcoming and supportive environment, making you feel at home.

One of the most amazing and great institute I have ever been to. I will complete almost 2 years now in this institute. Based on my journey I would really suggest this institute to all if you are much interested in dancing.
Age grp doesn't matter here. All are welcomed here.
In this 2 years I have really learned a lot. ASHISH SIR and SHRADDHA MAM and all the instructors are very supportive. There was a time when I didn't even think that I would be able to stand on stage and perform with confidence because I was the person with who was really afraid to step on the stage. But an constant support and guidance given by ASHISH sir and SHRADDHA mam helped me to believe that I can also perform on the stage and made me realize it. This year I appeared for 10th boards exam. Most of the dancers at this age take a break from dance to study. But the constant support that I got from ASHISH sir and SHRADDHA mam made me and my parents think that I don't need a break! So , I would heartily recommend it to all !!

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Turrey
featured_reviews.review_text: Every class with Amit sir is more than just learning dance—it's about building confidence, expressing ourselves, and enjoying every moment of the journey. His energy, patience, and attention to every step make learning so much fun and inspire us to keep improving. He is so thorough with technicalities and believe me he is treat to watch while dancing. Have to learn so much form him. Amit sir , I'm truly grateful to be your student. Thank you for making every class something I look forward to..you rock!!!

featured_reviews.name: Geeta Nair
featured_reviews.review_text:
ABDS is the perfect place for dance enthusiast.. My daughter Nidhi after her bharatnatyam started learning with Amit. ❤️

Amit is a brilliant choreographer dancer and singer .. all in one ..🎉🎉

Amit as a person is wonderful grounded and very understanding.. ❤️❤️

featured_reviews.name: Ravinder Pal
featured_reviews.review_text:
Hello my kids recently joined Abds. In school they already had Dance as a subject. But they were never interested a lot. Ever since they've joined Amit sir class, they wait for their session. It was quite surprising that Amit sir has the magic in him that he creates interest in non dancers too. Thank you so much sir.
Best Dance classes Abds

featured_reviews.name: akanksha tawde
featured_reviews.review_text: Amit Sir is an exceptional dance instructor.His passion for dance is contagious.His teaching style is supportive & challenging I have seen significant improvement in my dancing style since joining their class.I’m so grateful to have Amit Sir as my dance teacher.

featured_reviews.name: Rajendra Vaishampayan
featured_reviews.review_text: Amitji is a very talented and creative choreohrapher with high cocompetency. Dance and teaching dance is his passion. He puts his heart and soul into his work.

featured_reviews.name: Milind Tawde
featured_reviews.review_text: Amit sir is a gem of a person and a fantastic performer, choreographer and singer as well. My best wishes for his continued success

featured_reviews.name: Sharad Shirali
featured_reviews.review_text: Everybody is a dance teacher nowadays cos it's a thriving business. But if you really want to learn the correct steps and probably make it a profession - no hanky-panky, ABDS is the right place. No two ways about it !!
